title: legacy-task-state.schema.json
description: Legacy task state (BRS Section 64.6): the three fields the core reads from a v0.3.0 state file work/state/<TASK-id>.yaml written under the FR-036 grammar of BRS 1.2. The core projects `task_state` onto these three members before validating; every other value of the file is opaque and is ignored. The file is never rewritten.
